_note: Batch 7: ten REAL Perth sleep & recovery businesses researched from public information on 8 Aug 2026. Introduces the 'recovery' practice category (created on import): recovery studios, saunas, ice baths, cryotherapy, red light, hyperbaric oxygen and behavioural sleep support. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings. Copy is strictly factual — facilities, equipment, session lengths, prices and hours; no therapeutic or outcome claims. Beyond Rest and Clear Mind Studio were excluded as they already exist in the directory.

listings.name: Recovery Lab Jolimont
listings.blurb: Private infrared sauna suites, ice baths, NormaTec compression boots, Compex muscle stimulation and NuCalm neuro-acoustic relaxation under one Jolimont roof, open seven days with evenings to 8pm early in the week. First-timers can take a ten-day recovery experience for $79.
listings._source: recoverylab.com.au — full address, phone, email, weekly hours, $79 intro offer confirmed; standard session prices not published

listings.name: Reclab
listings.blurb: Perth's first fully dedicated recovery centre: cold plunge pools alongside a magnesium-enriched hot plunge for contrast work, a Finnish sauna, steam room, red light therapy, compression boots and IV drips. Memberships run in two tiers with casual dips available, and professional teams train through here.
listings._source: reclab.com.au — suburb, phone, facilities, membership tiers confirmed; street address, email, prices and hours not published

listings.name: Element Health Centres
listings.blurb: Whole-body and spot cryotherapy, hyperbaric oxygen, red light therapy, infrared sauna and a Theta Chamber across centres in Claremont and Duncraig. Cryotherapy sessions run up to three minutes at $50, and six-week structured protocols are offered for recovery and longevity programs. Open Monday to Saturday.
listings._source: elementcentre.com.au — Claremont address, services, $50 cryo pricing, protocol pricing confirmed; Duncraig second centre at 11/209 Warwick Rd

listings.name: Hyper O2
listings.blurb: A boutique hyperbaric oxygen clinic in the Kardinya Commercial Centre running two hard monoplace chambers, with staff certified by the International Hyperbarics Association and continuous monitoring through every session. A first session is $60, and free parking sits at the front door.
listings._source: hypero2.com.au — full address, phone, email, chamber details, $60 first session confirmed; hours not published

listings.name: Locked In Recovery & Performance
listings.blurb: Ice baths, traditional and infrared saunas and contrast sessions in private one-hour bookings for singles or pairs. Prices are stated plainly: $45 a session, $80 for two, a five-pack at $200, or a $50 weekly membership covering up to three visits. Group sessions run too.
listings._source: lockedinrecoveryandperformance.com — full address, phone, email, complete price list confirmed; hours not published

listings.name: Ultimate Recovery Lounge
listings.blurb: Full-spectrum infrared sauna, an Odin ice bath running Nordic-cycle contrast sessions, IV vitamin infusions and quiet private recovery rooms, operated by licensed health professionals for Perth's northern corridor. Staffed Tuesday, Thursday to Sunday 9.30am–2.30pm, with out-of-hours bookings by arrangement.
listings._source: ultimaterecoverylounge.com — suburb, services, staffed hours, licensed-professional operation confirmed; street address, phone, email and prices not published

listings.name: Sleep Matters
listings.blurb: Perth's first dedicated behavioural sleep medicine service: a team of sleep psychologists working with adults, teens and children in West Perth and Como, and by telehealth Australia-wide. The four-session Goodnight group program delivers CBT-I on Saturday mornings at $600 with Medicare rebates available, and individual sessions attract rebates under a mental health care plan with GP referral.
listings._source: sleepmattersperth.com.au — both clinic addresses, phone, program pricing ($600, Medicare rebates), team structure confirmed; individual session fees not published

listings.name: Re-Boot Collective
listings.address: Scarborough Beach Rd, North Perth WA 6006
listings.blurb: A boutique health and wellness centre on Scarborough Beach Road pairing recovery with training: ice baths, Perth's first dry float tanks, red light therapy, infrared saunas and traditional Taiwanese massage alongside personal training and nutrition coaching. Open 6am to 10pm on weekdays and through the weekend.
listings._source: re-bootcollective.com.au — street (Scarborough Beach Rd), phone, email, hours, facilities confirmed; street number and prices not published

listings.name: Perth Cryo
listings.blurb: Whole-body cryotherapy in a state-of-the-art electric chamber — three minutes at minus ninety-five degrees — plus O2 AirPod oxygen therapy and infrared sauna in Currambine. Packages pair cryotherapy and sauna visits, with guest passes included in the larger bundles.
listings._source: perthcryo.com.au + booking listings — full address, phone, chamber details, package structure confirmed; session prices vary, not fully published

listings.name: Thrive Wellness Centre
listings.address: 6 Mint St, East Victoria Park WA 6101
listings.blurb: The only Perth centre running both a soft-shell and a two-person APEX hard-shell hyperbaric chamber, alongside red light therapy, remedial massage, naturopathy, chiropractic, physiotherapy and acupuncture. A sixty-minute HBOT session adds to any treatment for $40, and doors are open seven days, to 8pm on weekdays.
listings._source: thrivewellnesscentre.com.au — full address, phone, email, hours, both chamber types, $40 HBOT add-on confirmed; standalone HBOT prices not published
